title: HarmFlow event
description: A normalized event, as written to one JSONL file per execution and delivered on the SSE stream. Event types are object.action in snake_case.

id.description: Incremental identifier; a reconnecting client asks for the events after the last one it received.

message.description: Short text: the daemon's own in en-US, beside its messageKey, or the agent's text, tool output, and a script's output in their original language, which are never translated. The dashboard translates the label of the type. A script.output event carries one line of the program's output, with its stream in payload.stream: stdout or stderr. A harness.network_waiting event carries the harness's own notice that it cannot reach its provider and waits for the network, once for each stretch of such notices.

messageKey.description: One of MessageKey in contracts/api/openapi.yaml: the dashboard shows the message in the interface's language from it and params.

params.description: The values of the messageKey's text, all strings (MessageParams in contracts/api/openapi.yaml).

payload.description: An error in the payload is a text too: error in en-US, with errorKey and errorParams beside it. A harness.checked event, sent when a harness's check ends, carries the readiness found in payload.readiness, and no message. A harness.sign_in_failed event carries how the sign-in ended in payload.outcome: unknown_screen, ended, or succeeded when the harness still does not read signed in. A harness.token_expiring event carries when the token expires, by the count of its year, in payload.expiresAt.
